T1158.long: To prevent normal users from accidentally changing special files on a system, most operating systems have the concept of a ‘hidden’ file. These files don’t show up when a user browses the file system with a GUI or when using normal commands on the command line. Users must explicitly ask to show the hidden files either via a series of Graphical User Interface (GUI) prompts or with command line switches (dir /a for Windows and ls –a for Linux and macOS).

strings: We are pleased to provide for your review the renewal underwriting Package submission for Havergal College for the policy period June 30, 2021 to June 30, 2022.

We would appreciate receiving your best terms in accordance with the limits and deductibles indicated in the coverage specifications at your earliest opportunity and no later than 25th June, 2021. Please direct any inquiries and provide terms to:
Sheila Golden, ACII, CRM, FCIP, B.Ed.(Hons), Vice President Integrated Broking
Havergal College a/o Havergal College Foundation a/o Havergal Properties Limited a/o The Havergal Old Girls Association
The following is a brief description of the operations of the Insured:

Havergal College is an independent elementary and secondary girls school based in midtown Toronto. It educates girls from Grades JK to 12 with a reputation as a leader in girls' education.  Havergal is ranked second out of 749 secondary schools in the province of Ontario (see Fraser Institute EQAO rankings published 4/19/15).
Both dates at 12:01 a.m. standard time at the location address of the insured.
Notice to Others / Third Parties of Cancellation
as per Certificates on file with the Insurer
Declaration of Emergency by Canadian public authority;
Blanket Mortgagees, Loss Payees and Additional Insureds
Renewal terms to be quoted with commission
Renewal terms to include various changes as indicated within the coverage specifications.
Policies to be issued within 60 days of binding.
HAVERGAL COLLEGE A/O THE HAVERGAL COLLEGE FOUNDATION A/O HAVERGAL PROPERTIES LIMITED A/O HAVERGAL OLD GIRLS ASSOCIATION

Coverage is provided for losses caused by direct physical loss or direct physical damage arising from ALL RISKS, unless otherwise excluded including replacement cost, by-laws, debris removal plus the EXTENSIONS shown below.
Property of Every Description (excluding Rental Income, Extra Expense and Business Income)
Earthquake Limit (includes POED, Rental Income, Extra Expense and Business Income)
Flood Limit (includes POED, Rental Income, Extra Expense and Business Income)
Business Interruption per occurrence/aggregate (24 Months indemnity including $7 million Extra Expense)
Murder/Suicide, Food Poisoning, Defective Sanitation, Vermin
Failure of Telecommunication Service Extension, per occurrence

The limit of coverage for loss of any or all items under these EXTENSIONS shall be $1,000,000 per occurrence for each (unless stated otherwise) of the ON and OFF Premises Extensions (listed below), but subject to an aggregate limit of $1,000,000 for all losses combined.
Personal Property of Officers, Employees and Administrators ($10,000 per policy year)
Personal Property of Volunteers (maximum recovery of $250 per Volunteer, $10,000 per policy year)
Donated Property ($500 per bequest), subject to a single article limit of ($5,000)
Private Roadways, Walkways, Parking Lots ($25,000 per occurrence)
Emergency Services Damage to the Grounds
Pollution Clean Up & Removal ($25,000 per aggregate)
Computer System Breakdown coverage, including Reinstatement of Data ($25,000 any one occurrence)
Trees & Shrubs in the Open ($1,500 per plant, tree or shrub, $25,000 per occurrence)
Cost of Preparing Proof of Loss
Automatic Fire Suppression System Recharge Expense
Arson, Theft, and Vandalism Reward ($10,000 aggregate)
Consequential Loss Assumption (Off Premises Service) ($50,000 per occurrence)
Temporary Accommodation for Resident Staff, Storage & Kennel accommodations for Shelter Animals ($25,000 per occurrence)
Property Temporarily removed from Premises/Unnamed Locations
Extra Expense - (Included in Business Interruption limit)
Extra Expense - (Included in Business Interruption limit)

Insurance may be cancelled by the Insurer(s) by mailing at least 30 days written notice to the Named Insured at the address stated herein, except for Non-Payment of premium which is 15 days by registered mail or 5 days hand delivered.
